title: Augment Receipt
description: Receipt produced after Augment writes a complete experimental module implementation.

blueprint_id.description: Blueprint ID this implementation was built from.

augment_path.description: Path to the experimental module directory.

fill_markers_remaining.description: Must be 0. Any remaining [FILL] markers = incomplete Augment.

structural_check_passed.description: Whether experimental module passes structural checks: SKILL.md sections complete, skill-rules.json valid, receipt schema valid JSON Schema.

source_module_version.description: For AUGMENT type: the version of the source module at time of copy.

sections_modified.description: SKILL.md sections changed from the source module (AUGMENT type only).
